help.title: Getting started
help.subtitle: Turn a photo into a low-poly triangulation, step by step.

load.title: Load an image
load.body: Use the image button at the bottom of the modifier bar, the vertical strip of tools to the right of the canvas. Pick any photo to polygonize.

points.title: Generate the base points
points.body: Open Point generation in the right panel. Detail spacing sets how tightly points pack in detailed areas, Flat-area spacing does the same for flat regions, and Canvas border points sets how many sit along each edge. Smaller spacing means more, finer triangles.

trace.title: Trace edges automatically
trace.body: Optional shortcut: open Trace in the right panel to detect the image's edges and turn them into editable outlines, gathered in their own group. Tune Faint edges and Strong edges to control how much detail is picked up, then run Trace image. It gives you a head start you can refine by hand.

emphasize.title: Emphasize what matters
emphasize.body: Pick a tool from the modifier bar (polyline, curve, bezier, or circle) and draw over a feature you want to keep crisp, like an edge. Press Space to apply, Escape to cancel.

export.title: Save or export
export.body: Save your work as a project to continue later, or export the finished result as SVG, PDF, or an image.

hotkeys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
hotkeys.body: A list of hotkeys sits in the bottom-left corner of the canvas.

stats.title: Live statistics
stats.body: Point and triangle counts are shown in the bottom-right corner.

performance.title: Mind the point count
performance.body: Many points strain the device and can feel slow. Don't push detail to the maximum right away - start moderate and refine for comfortable, responsive work.

hotkeys.title: Shortcuts
hotkeys.addPoint: Add a point on the curve
hotkeys.extrudePoint: Extrude a new point from an end
hotkeys.splitModifier: Split the modifier at a point

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.tip: Hover the canvas to highlight the nearest modifier, click to select. Escape or ~ returns here.

polyline.label: Polyline
polyline.tip: Click to add vertices. Space or click the first vertex to finish, Escape to cancel.

catmullrom.label: Catmull-Rom curve
catmullrom.tip: Click to add control points. Space or click the first to finish, Escape to cancel.

bezier.label: Bezier pen
bezier.tip: Click for an anchor, or drag to pull symmetric handles. Click the first anchor to close, Space to finish, Escape to cancel.

circle.label: Circle (center & radius)
circle.tip: Click a point on the edge, then the center.

circle3.label: Circle (3 points)
circle3.tip: Click three points on the circle to fit it.

modifiers.title: Modifiers
modifiers.hint: Non-destructive layers over the base points. Pick a tool on the left; select a card to edit its points on the stage. Drag cards to reorder or to move them between groups.

newGroup.label: New group
newGroup.tip: Create a group to organize modifiers.

sortAlpha.label: Sort A-Z
sortAlpha.tip: Sort modifiers and groups alphabetically by name.

clearLoose.label: Delete ungrouped modifiers
clearLoose.tip: Click repeatedly to count down, then delete every modifier that is not in a group (groups are kept). Wait 2s to cancel.

clearAll.label: Delete all
clearAll.tip: Click repeatedly to count down, then delete every modifier and group. Wait 2s to cancel.

modifiers.dragGroupTip: Drag to move this group up or down in the stack.
modifiers.caretTip: Show or hide this group's modifiers. Opening a group collapses the others.
modifiers.renameTip: Click to select this group (new modifiers land here); double-click to rename.
modifiers.countTip: Number of modifiers in this group.
modifiers.muteTip: Skip this group in the pipeline so its modifiers stop affecting the points.

solo.label: Mute other groups
solo.tip: Mute every other group so only this one affects the points.

absorb.label: Absorb loose modifiers
absorb.tip: Move every ungrouped modifier into this group.

ungroup.label: Ungroup (keeps modifiers)
ungroup.tip: Click repeatedly to count down, then ungroup (modifiers are kept). Wait 2s to cancel.

deleteGroup.label: Delete group and modifiers
deleteGroup.tip: Click repeatedly to count down, then delete this group and every modifier in it. Wait 2s to cancel.

modifiers.dragCard: Drag the card to reorder or move into a group

eject.label: Move out of group
eject.tip: Take this modifier out of its group; it becomes an ungrouped modifier.

removeModifier.label: Remove modifier
removeModifier.tip: Click repeatedly to count down, then remove this modifier. Wait 2s to cancel.

modifiers.pointsTip: How many points to scatter along this modifier. More points give it finer, more detailed triangles.
modifiers.closedTip: Join the last point back to the first so the outline forms a closed loop.
modifiers.polylineTip: Connect the points with straight segments.
modifiers.catmullromTip: Connect the points with a smooth curve that passes through each one.

pointGen.title: Point generation
pointGen.hint: Scatters points across the image to build the triangle mesh. Points cluster tightly where the image has detail and spread out across flat areas. Changing these settings regenerates the points; your drawn modifiers are kept.
pointGen.perSideTip: How many points to place along each edge of the image. More gives a cleaner, straighter frame.
pointGen.minRadiusTip: Smallest gap between points in busy, detailed areas. Lower = more points and finer triangles where the image is sharp.
pointGen.maxRadiusTip: Largest gap between points in smooth, flat areas. Higher = fewer points and bigger triangles where the image is plain.
pointGen.seedTip: Random seed for the point scatter. The same seed always reproduces the same points; change it for a different arrangement.

trace.title: Trace
trace.hint: Automatically finds edges in the image and turns them into editable outlines, added as a new group. Use it as a starting point, then adjust the outlines by hand.
trace.lowTip: How much faint detail to keep. Higher ignores soft, low-contrast edges; lower traces more of them.
trace.highTip: How bold an edge must be to start an outline. Higher keeps only the boldest lines; lower picks up more.
trace.simplifyTip: Removes wobble from outlines. Higher = smoother lines with fewer points; lower stays closer to the image.
trace.minPointsTip: Discard outlines with fewer points than this. Raise it to remove tiny specks.
trace.minLengthTip: Discard outlines shorter than this. Raise it to remove short stray lines.
trace.runTip: Trace the current image into the "Traced contours" group with these settings (overwrites it).

color.title: Color
color.hint: Color sampled from the image. Changes recompute all colors.
color.medianTip: Use the median of the sampled pixels. Ignores outliers, giving a cleaner, more representative color.
color.averageTip: Use the average of the sampled pixels. Blends everything, including bright or dark specks.
color.samplesTip: How many pixels to sample inside each triangle when computing its color. More samples give a steadier, more accurate color.
